subject: *: enable infoschema v2 by default (#55229)
summary: Sessionctx change only: updates `DefTiDBSchemaCacheSize` (backing `@@global.tidb_schema_cache_size`) default from `0` to `512 * 1024 * 1024` bytes (512 MiB). Since infoschema V2 is gated on `SchemaCacheSize > 0`, this effectively enables infoschema V2 by default for clusters without an explicit override (while still allowing users to disable V2 by setting the global variable to `0`).
